Glossary
Arachidoinic acid (20:4n-6) A 20 carbon omega-6 fatty acid which is a precursor of eicosanoids.
Eicosanoids A family of signaling molecules made by oxidation of twenty-carbon essential fatty acids; they include the
prostaglandins, thromboxanes, leukotrienes and epoxyeicosatrienoic acids.
